rationale: Correct the existing Crown Castle Small Cells Solutions record in place to its post-close identity, Arium Networks. Direct manager, company and SEC evidence establishes that EQT Active Core Infrastructure I closed the acquisition on May 1, 2026, Arium launched as the standalone small-cell and venue-network platform, and Crown Castle became the former owner. Preserve the predecessor names as aliases, exclude the separately sold Zayo fiber business, and do not infer a single EQT economic percentage from nested co-investment interests.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Arium Networks LLC is a U.S. small-cell, distributed-antenna-system and venue-network infrastructure platform created from Crown Castle's former Small Cell business. It designs, deploys and manages outdoor and in-building wireless networks for the three largest U.S. mobile network operators and venue customers. EQT Active Core Infrastructure I announced the acquisition in March 2025 and completed it through Small Cells HoldCo Inc. on May 1, 2026, when Arium launched as a standalone company. Arium reported more than 100,000 small cells on air or under contract across 43 states at launch and is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. EQT continues to list Arium as current. The separately sold Crown Castle Fiber Solutions business now owned by Zayo is outside this company boundary. Public sources do not disclose one comparable EQT economic stake across the nested fund and co-investment structure, and no later platform sale, sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 29, 2026.
